name: SEO-AI-crawlers (m14)
description: Audit AI crawler access and citability for a page — confirm retrieval/citation bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) are allowed and the Googlebot vs Google-Extended split. It gives the agent a clearer input/output frame for search and SEO workflows: what context to ask for, what decisions to make, and what usable artifact to return.
